# Game Idea: Space Dodge

- Top‑down HTML canvas where the player pilots a ship that drifts forward.
- Click or tap to steer; asteroids spawn from the edges.
- **Lose condition:** collision with any asteroid or running out of fuel.
- Score is based on survival time.

<content>
1: // Simple Space Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return; // canvas not found
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
9: 
10:   // Sound assets
11:   const sounds = {
12:     thrust: new Audio('thrust.wav'),
13:     explosion: new Audio('explosion.wav'),
14:     bgm: new Audio('bgm.mp3'),
15:   };
16:   // Background music loop (optional)
17:   sounds.bgm.loop = true;
18:   sounds.bgm.volume = 0.3;
19:   // Start music (ignore promise errors for autoplay restrictions)
20:   sounds.bgm.play().catch(() => {});
21: 
22:   // Ship definition
23:   const ship = {
24:     x: width / 2,
25:     y: height / 2,
26:     radius: 10,
27:     angle: 0,
28:     speed: 2,
29:     vx: 0,
30:     vy: 0,
31:     fuel: 100, // percent
32:   };
33: 
34:   // Asteroid pool
35:   const asteroids = [];
36:   const maxAsteroids = 30;
37: 
38:   // Score (seconds survived)
39:   let startTime = performance.now();
40:   let score = 0;
41:   let gameOver = false;
42: 
43:   // Helper: distance between two points
44:   const dist = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => Math.hypot(x2 - x1, y2 - y1);
45: 
46:   // Spawn an asteroid from a random edge
47:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
48:     const size = 8 + Math.random() * 12;
49:     let x, y, vx, vy;
50:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
51:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5;
52:     if (edge === 0) { // top
53:       x = Math.random() * width;
54:       y = -size;
55:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
56:       vy = speed;
57:     } else if (edge === 1) { // right
58:       x = width + size;
59:       y = Math.random() * height;
60:       vx = -speed;
61:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
62:     } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
63:       x = Math.random() * width;
64:       y = height + size;
65:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
66:       vy = -speed;
67:     } else { // left
68:       x = -size;
69:       y = Math.random() * height;
70:       vx = speed;
71:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
72:     }
73:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius: size });
74:   };
75: 
76:   // Steering: click/tap sets ship angle toward pointer
77:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
78:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
79:     const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
80:     const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
81:     ship.angle = Math.atan2(my - ship.y, mx - ship.x);
82:     ship.vx = Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
83:     ship.vy = Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
84:     // Play thrust sound
85:     sounds.thrust.currentTime = 0;
86:     sounds.thrust.play().catch(() => {});
87:   });
88: 
89:   const update = (dt) => {
90:     if (gameOver) return;
91: 
92:     // Move ship (drift)
93:     ship.x += ship.vx;
94:     ship.y += ship.vy;
95: 
96:     // Wrap ship around edges
97:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width;
98:     if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
99:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += height;
100:     if (ship.y > height) ship.y -= height;
101: 
102:     // Reduce fuel
103:     ship.fuel -= dt * 0.01; // fuel per ms
104:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) ship.fuel = 0;
105: 
106:     // Update asteroids
107:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
108:       a.x += a.vx;
109:       a.y += a.vy;
110:     });
111:     // Remove off‑screen asteroids
112:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
113:       const a = asteroids[i];
114:       if (a.x < -50 || a.x > width + 50 || a.y < -50 || a.y > height + 50) {
115:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
116:       }
117:     }
118: 
119:     // Spawn new asteroids gradually
120:     if (asteroids.length < maxAsteroids && Math.random() < 0.02) {
121:       spawnAsteroid();
122:     }
123: 
124:     // Collision detection
125:     for (const a of asteroids) {
126:       if (dist(ship.x, ship.y, a.x, a.y) < ship.radius + a.radius) {
127:         gameOver = true;
128:         // Play explosion sound
129:         sounds.explosion.currentTime = 0;
130:         sounds.explosion.play().catch(() => {});
131:         break;
132:       }
133:     }
134:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
135: 
136:     // Update score
137:     score = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
138:   };
139: 
140:   const draw = () => {
141:     // Background gradient
142:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
143:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
144:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
145:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
146:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
147: 
148:     // Starfield (static points)
149:     if (!window._stars) {
150:       window._stars = Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({
151:         x: Math.random() * width,
152:         y: Math.random() * height,
153:         radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
154:         opacity: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
155:       }));
156:     }
157:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
158:     for (const s of window._stars) {
159:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.opacity;
160:       ctx.beginPath();
161:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
162:       ctx.fill();
163:     }
164:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
165: 
166:     // Ship with gradient and subtle thrust trail
167:     ctx.save();
168:     // thrust trail (simple line)
169:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.3)';
170:     ctx.lineWidth = 4;
171:     ctx.beginPath();
172:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x - Math.cos(ship.angle) * 14, ship.y - Math.sin(ship.angle) * 14);
173:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - Math.cos(ship.angle) * 4, ship.y - Math.sin(ship.angle) * 4);
174:     ctx.stroke();
175: 
176:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
177:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
178:     const shipGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 4, 0, 0, 12);
179:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
180:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#005');
181:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
182:     ctx.beginPath();
183:     ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
184:     ctx.lineTo(-8, -6);
185:     ctx.lineTo(-8, 6);
186:     ctx.closePath();
187:     ctx.fill();
188:     ctx.restore();
189: 
190:     // Asteroids with radial gradient for depth
191:     for (const a of asteroids) {
192:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.3, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
193:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
194:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
195:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
196:       ctx.beginPath();
197:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
198:       ctx.fill();
199:     }
200: 
201:     // HUD
202:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
203:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
204:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${ship.fuel.toFixed(0)}%`, 10, 20);
205:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s`, 10, 40);
206:     if (gameOver) {
207:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
208:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
209:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
210:       ctx.font = 'bold 32px sans-serif';
211:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
212:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
213:     }
214:   };
215: 
216:   let last = performance.now();
217:   const loop = () => {
218:     const now = performance.now();
219:     const dt = now - last;
220:     last = now;
221:     update(dt);
222:     draw();
223:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
224:   };
225:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
226: })();

(End of file - total 226 lines)
</content>
